rule: Trend ranking and entry signals are separate. A holding never makes a signal GREEN. GREEN means ORACLE entry criteria have been validated; ORANGE means thesis credible but at least one gate remains open; RED means entry criteria are not passed.

photonics.summary: AI clusters are pushing more bandwidth into optical links and photonic components as electrical interconnects hit power and distance limits.

power.summary: AI data-center demand is colliding with generation, grid, switchgear and cooling constraints.

minerals.summary: Supply-chain security is accelerating ex-China mining, separation, refining and magnet capacity.

cuas.summary: Drone proliferation is increasing demand for detection, autonomy, electronic warfare and counter-UAS effectors.

physical.summary: AI is moving into robots and edge systems, but listed-company economic capture remains early and fragmented.

GEV.reason: Validated AI power/grid beneficiary in the current ORACLE decision state.

TSEM.reason: Optical/semiconductor exposure is credible; entry gate remains incomplete.

MP.reason: Rare-earth sovereignty thesis is proven; timing/entry gate remains incomplete.

AVAV.reason: Counter-UAS exposure is proven; timing/entry gate remains incomplete.

AMBA.reason: Physical-AI exposure is credible but current entry criteria are not validated.
